arbitration_protocol.resolution_rule: When human raters disagree or LLM judge diverges from initial human marks, the arbiter inspects the verbatim database snapshot records. If an assertion is factual in the snapshot despite not matching the prompt blueprint exactly, the answer is ruled PASS. If an assertion is hallucinated or an essential fact omitted, it is ruled FAIL. All original and adjudicated marks are preserved.
